_comment: Phase D power analysis, regime (a): near-deterministic / pseudo-replication
(study plan 8.5(a)). PROVISIONAL -- nothing here is frozen until E3.
This regime SOLVES FOR num_problems, so it runs first and alone; regimes
(b)-(e) then run at whatever menus-per-cell this selects. Sweeping the
others first would mean paying for the whole grid twice.
Observations are PRESENTATIONS, not menus: M_total = menus x 2. The design
generator's M_per_cell is therefore MENUS per cell, and the harness
rho_copy is the probability that a repeat presentation copies the first.
0.0 reproduces the independence assumption the inference model makes;
raising it is the stress. Calibrate against the observed position-flip
rate (8.8) once a real smoke run exists -- until then it is swept.
(1000 warmup + 2000 sampling, adapt_delta 0.95). Phase C's cost estimate
was wrong by 1.8x precisely because the benchmark and the config used
different settings, so any timing measured here must use the real ones.
